coverage.deduplication: Exact sorted reduced Fraction tuples; one representative per2/3-number multiset, separately for each singleton target.

checkpoint_selection: Existing validation objective only; this suite never selects a checkpoint.
scope: Exhaustive finite-domain fitting, not unseen initial-question generalization.2/3-number suffixes are deduplicated across roots. Unsolvable queries remain in distance/reachability evaluation; completion uses every positive-distance solvable query. Local held query goals may occur as training goals or state inputs in other questions.

target_switch.scope: Same root, both singleton goals solvable and exact optimal FIRST physical action sets disjoint. All candidates retained; teacher checks follow model action selection.

failure_structure.scope: Post-selection diagnosis only; no optimizer update or new labels. Exact truth inspected after model choices.
